whyItMatters: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
actions: Remove the literal, rotate the credential and inject it from the CI secret store at run time. Specifically: fix a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm auth.json no longer carries a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
